name: korra
description: Korra is your AI market analyst. Send her your meeting prep, decisions and notes so she has them ready on your calls, and ask her for live crypto and market data.

interface.longDescription:
Korra is an AI analyst for crypto and markets who also joins your calls. With this connection, ChatGPT can send Korra what you worked on here (meeting preparation, decisions, documents, notes) and Korra keeps it private to you and has it ready on your next call and whenever you talk to her. ChatGPT can also ask Korra questions: live crypto and market prices, news, on-chain and social readings, her predictions, and anything you have sent her.

Intended for people who use Korra (korra.finance) and want their work in ChatGPT to carry over. You need a Korra account and approve the connection once.

Limitations: Korra receives only what you ask ChatGPT to send, as a summary and notes; she never reads your ChatGPT history. Market information is for information, not advice; Korra does not place trades or move money.
defaultPrompt: Send my prep for Thursday's call to Korra
Ask Korra what bitcoin is doing right now
What have I sent Korra this week?

positive.prompt: Send this to Korra: I'm meeting Robin on Thursday at 3pm about the family app pilot. We want a December pilot and to keep pricing open.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT sends a title, a short summary and the meeting (Robin, Thursday 15:00). Korra confirms it is saved and that she will have it ready on that call with Robin.

positive.description: List what the user has sent Korra
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the items on the account, newest first, with dates; the meeting prep from the first case appears as a meeting with Robin.

positive.description: Ask Korra for a live market figure
positive.prompt: Ask Korra what bitcoin is doing right now.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Korra's answer with a live bitcoin price and a line of context, from Korra's own data rather than ChatGPT's knowledge. Information only, no advice to buy or sell.

positive.description: Brief Korra for an upcoming call
positive.prompt: Brief Korra for my call with Robin on Thursday: strengthen the case for a December pilot, and don't discuss our price floor.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT passes the goals and the red line. On the test account no call is booked with Korra yet, so Korra replies that she saved it as meeting prep for that call and explains how to invite her. No error.

positive.description: Get Korra's notes from a call
positive.prompt: Get Korra's notes from my last call.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the notes and transcript of the test account's most recent call with Korra, or a short message that Korra has not joined a call of this user's. No error.

negative.description: Whole chat history is not sent. ChatGPT should not pass the conversation to Korra; it offers to send a summary of one specific item instead.
negative.prompt: Send Korra my whole chat history.

negative.description: No trading. Korra does not buy or sell anything for users; no tool places an order and ChatGPT does not claim a trade happened.
negative.prompt: Ask Korra to buy 1 BTC for me.

negative.description: Out of scope. A general question unrelated to markets or the user's Korra items should be answered by ChatGPT without calling any Korra tool.
negative.prompt: What's a good recipe for banana bread?

review.commerce_description: No purchases, payments or upgrades happen in this plugin.

publication.release_notes: First release: send meeting prep, decisions and notes to Korra; ask Korra for live market data; brief her for a call; get her call notes; list what you sent her.
